propositions: Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.8 declare identical 1,000,000 token windows in MODEL_LADDER, causing context-limit escalation from sonnet to opus to gain zero additional context capacity

A retry at opus after a sonnet context-limit failure is guaranteed to fail again with the same error but at higher cost, while operators misdiagnose it as 'even opus failed' rather than 'no actual escalation occurred'
The declared window figures are verified correct against the provider's live Models API (max_input_tokens), so the defect is in escalation logic consumption, not data accuracy
Two context-limit retry loops (pass1_with_ladder and run_focused_finder) must filter MODEL_LADDER rungs to exclude any rung whose declared window is not strictly greater than the last kept rung

escalation_rungs must be a new function that returns models_at_or_above with no-op rungs removed, while models_at_or_above and largest_window_tokens remain unchanged to preserve task 7761 provider-stickiness test coverage
